# Auroha Tejve Private Limited

> Auroha Tejve Private Limited is a software studio that builds Shopify apps, high-converting Shopify stores, B2B SaaS products, and applied AI solutions for modern commerce businesses.

Auroha Tejve is a small, senior engineering team — no bench of juniors, no
account-manager layer between clients and the people building. Engagements
run end to end: discovery, product architecture and design, weekly-iteration
builds, launch, and post-launch support.

## Services

- **Shopify App Development** — public and private Shopify apps built for
  the App Store, including App Store submissions, billing & subscriptions,
  and embedded admin UI.
- **Shopify Store Development** — custom, high-converting storefronts on
  Shopify and Shopify Plus, including custom theme builds, headless
  storefronts, and CRO & performance work.
- **B2B SaaS Development** — end-to-end product builds for B2B software
  companies: product architecture, multi-tenant infrastructure, and design
  systems.
- **AI Solutions** — applied AI and automation for commerce and business
  workflows, from LLM-powered features to data & retrieval pipelines.

## Products

- **Ordzo** (in development) — AI-based order management for ecommerce.
  Automates order triage, prioritization, fulfillment routing, and
  real-time exception detection across channels. https://ordzo.vercel.app/
- **OrderFlow** (now building) — WhatsApp-based order taking and
  management. Turns WhatsApp into a full ordering platform with catalog
  browsing, automated confirmations, and a shared team inbox.
  https://orderflow-sandbox.vercel.app/

## Case studies

- Varkey's Cafe (Bengaluru) — adopted OrderFlow to automate end-to-end
  order management, removing manual order-handling work from staff time.
